desc: update data files from IEEE Standards Association such as the OUI and IAB lists
u: update-ieee-data - update data files from IEEE Standards Association such as the OUI and IAB lists

update-ieee-data fetches the current version of the OUI and IAB lists from IEEE Standards Association and installs it, if the installed versions is older than 5 days.

This utility requires curl, wget or libwww-perl to be installed.
<dl><dt data-o="">-q</dt><dd>Be quiet. Do not output messages.</dd><dt data-o="">-f</dt><dd>Force the update, even if the file is newer than 5 days.</dd></dl>
